summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of SUKI ledger and stock app. Tested all 9 routes, PIN gate, core workflows (LISTA/BAYAD), customer ledger, stock management, and responsive design at mobile (360×800) and tablet (1024×768) viewports. All major features working correctly.

design_issues.issue: Table caption and th[scope='col'] attributes not verified in all tests - accessibility feature may be missing

passed_tests: PIN gate: Correct PIN (1234) unlocks and redirects to Till page
PIN gate: Wrong PIN shows error message and resets
PIN gate: On-screen keypad with data-testid works correctly
Till page: Item grid displays 58 in-stock items with monograms, prices, and stock counts
Till page: Search field filters items
Till page: Adding items to sale shows running sale tray with total
Till page: Incrementing items updates quantity and total correctly
LISTA flow: Opens customer picker with sorted customers showing utang in red
LISTA flow: Selecting customer navigates to ledger and creates PENDING entry
LISTA flow: PENDING label disappears after ~1.2s sync
BAYAD flow: Cash sale clears sale tray and updates day totals
Lista page: Shows TOTAL UTANG ₱3,273
Lista page: Shows NEXT PAYDAY kinsenas in 0d
Lista page: Shows PAYDAY band 'Today is Kinsenas. Most suki will settle.'
Lista page: Customer rows display monogram, name, purok, days since last bayad, and utang in red
Customer ledger: Table structure with DATE, ENTRY, AMOUNT, BALANCE columns
Customer ledger: Bayad entries shown in green with minus sign
Customer ledger: Running balance calculated correctly
Customer ledger: Amounts right-aligned in monospace
Customer ledger: RECORD A PAYMENT button opens payment sheet
Payment recording: Partial payment (₱50) recorded successfully
Payment recording: New Bayad entry appears with PENDING then syncs
Stock page: Filter tabs (All, Running low, Out) work correctly
Stock page: OUT items have both strike-through and OUT label (accessibility)
Stock page: Restock list button navigates to /restock
Item page: Tingi section shows Buy, Sell, Conversion, Margin per piece, Margin per pack
Item page: Buy price input with data-testid='item-buy-price' works
Item page: Changing buy price updates margins live
Item page: Save button appears when price changed
Restock page: Shows items below reorder point or empty state
Restock page: Checkboxes toggle line-through and update total
Restock page: Estimated total with data-testid='restock-total' displays correctly
Day page: Shows 'Closing up' with date
Day page: Displays Cash today, Bayad received (green), Utang extended (red), Transactions
Day page: Shows 'Should be in the tin' with large peso amount
Day page: Settings button navigates to /settings
Settings page: Inputs for storeName, barangay, defaultReorderPoint present
Settings page: Shows payday information (Kinsenas, Katapusan)
Settings page: Lock the counter button works and redirects to /unlock
Sync indicator: Clickable with data-testid='sync-indicator'
Sync indicator: Opens sync queue sheet showing operations
Sync indicator: Shows SYNCED status when queue empty
Money formatting: All amounts display as ₱ + integer (no decimals)
Money formatting: Thousands separators used (e.g., ₱3,273)
Responsive design: No horizontal scroll at 360px mobile viewport
Responsive design: No horizontal scroll at 1024×768 tablet viewport
Responsive design: Tablet viewport displays correctly
Tap targets: All checked buttons meet 48px minimum size
Accessibility: Skip links present on pages
Accessibility: OUT items have both visual (strike-through) and text (OUT label) indicators
Navigation: Bottom bar with TILL, LISTA, STOCK, DAY links works
Navigation: All 9 routes accessible and functional
